_note: OUR OWN 8 categories, intentionally distinct from InsideTracker (renamed/merged/regrouped). Membership is explicit here. Markers may appear in several. Wearable-derived markers are included where a published interval exists for them (BMI, sleep duration, resting heart rate, blood oxygen), so a ring and a blood panel feed the same eight scores. See _wearableNote in markers.json. Editable.
